origin: Minted beneath the long January dark where ice remembers every footprint, POLARNIGHT was struck as a seasonal gold coin for players who kept the first watch. Its face bears the quiet horizon of Nation Borealis.
lore: The oracle recorded its first block when the sun had not risen for weeks. In The Stash, POLARNIGHT became the reserve coin for patient wallets and midnight market makers. Curator ledgers say its yield deepens whenever the northern sky refuses to blink.
utility: Holding POLARNIGHT during January grants a small Night Watch yield bonus to seasonal bundles. Pair it with an aurora coin to improve darkness-route discovery rewards.
curatorNote: The dark is not empty; it is compounding.
